albums.title: Dhaka Duathlon 2026
albums.summary: Run 5 km, ride 30 km, run 5 km — in steady rain on the roads around Dhaka. Wet tarmac on the bike, puddled village lanes on the final run, and a finisher medal at 2:10:00.
